# `edis_attachment_files`

**Selected USITC attachment-file inventory**

One selected bulk-archive member associated with an investigation attachment, retaining the literal archive index and member inventory.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Selected retained investigation document, attachment and bulk-member observations. Native XML facts and literal archive-index facts remain separate; byte inventory does not establish PDF text or broader investigation coverage. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

**Data quality.** The rulemaking subject is the existing regulatory browse group. These rows describe USITC investigation filings, with literal investigation metadata retained.

- **Parquet file:** `edis_attachment_files.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
